subject: Renewal: Redwood subscription + staged PO for capacity uplift
messages:
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@globex.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@globex.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal initiation — capacity uplift + procurement hub pilot

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from procurement: our subscription renewal for Redwood is scheduled for the start of Q3. We’re planning a capacity uplift (reserved pool increase ~35%) and would like to pilot the procurement hub integration (Coupa) for vendor onboarding refresh so we can standardize evidence collection and PO handling.

Questions we need answered to get procurement moving:
- Do you have a standard mutual action plan for renewals that includes evidence checklist (SOC2 artifacts, data retention policy, SLA addendum)?
- Can we support a staggered PO (two-part PO split across Q3/Q4) to help the finance approval window?
- Are you able to accept DocuSign for the SOW addendum and a Coupa PO upload?

I attached our current renewal worksheet for context. Procurement would like a short plan and an initial JIRA ticket we can reference back to our internal queue.

Target: Procurement wants an executable plan and a DocuSign SOW by EOD 2027-04-05 to hit the billing cycle.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Alice Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
Globex Corporation
Attachment: globex_renewal_worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@globex.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal initiation — capacity uplift + procurement hub pilot

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. Outline below and I created a JIRA ticket for tracking: RED-1234 (link in metadata).

Short mutual action plan (high level):
1) Evidence & onboarding refresh (owner: Marissa) — deliver SOC2 snapshot, retention policy, audit log export method.
2) SOW addendum (owner: Jonas) — reflect +35% reserved capacity, billing split option (staggered PO), and SLA exception language until Dedicated capacity is provisioned.
3) PO & billing steps (owner: Ben) — provide Coupa-ready PO format and finance contact.
4) Sign, upload, provision (owner: Globex procurement + Redwood ops) — DocuSign by 2027-04-05, Coupa upload by 2027-04-07.

Attachments: I attached a renewal-handoff-checklist.pdf and a first-pass SOW-addendum-draft.docx for Legal review. I’ll also add a pricing summary to the JIRA ticket and request a short Coupa sample PO format from Ben.

Proposed next steps: 30-min sync tomorrow to run through evidence items and acceptance criteria, then Marissa will pull the SOC2 snippets and deliver to your procurement mailbox.

Availability: 2027-04-02 10:00–11:30 ET works for me.

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachment: renewal-handoff-checklist.pdf (document, 22KB); SOW-addendum-draft.docx (docx, 38KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@globex.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:01:00 -0400

Adding a few acceptance items from the CS/security side so procurement has clear artifacts to route to the compliance team:

Acceptance checklist (deliverables):
- SOC2 Type II latest report extract (redacted) — how to consume: we’ll provide a time-limited S3 link and a hashed checksum for verification.
- Data retention policy (customer-facing summary) — 1 page.
- Audit log export process — sample export + field mapping.
- Test plan for capacity cutover — short runbook for DNS/cutover windows.

On the staggered PO: finance usually accepts a PO with two line-items and billing schedule + a signed addendum referencing the PO numbers. If Globex needs, we can include a billing milestone table in the SOW addendum. This should speed approvals on your side.

I’ve opened RED-1234 in Jira and added the deliverables as sub-tasks (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1234). I’ll drop the SOC2 extract into the ticket when Legal signs off on redaction.

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 16:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal initiation — capacity uplift + procurement hub pilot

Hi Alice — quick pricing & procurement note.

Pricing impact for +35% reserved capacity: we can offer a two-tier commit that keeps unit cost flat for the first 12 months if the aggregate commit meets DEAL-48321 thresholds. If procurement prefers the two-part PO (split across Q3/Q4), finance will need the billing milestone table in the signed SOW addendum.

SLA exception: to account for the ramp while Dedicated capacity is provisioned (estimated 6–8 weeks from SOW signature), we can include a temporary SLA exception clause that provides service credits for availability drops below 99.5%. That clause will sunset once Dedicated capacity is live.

I’ve uploaded a simple pricing summary to RED-1234 and attached a one-page pricing extract here. Looping Legal on the SOW redline is OK — suggest we use DocuSign powerform to speed signatures.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing-extract-48321.pdf (pdf, 12KB)
